derivedFingerprints.basis: Five retained command receipts (argv) plus the shared authenticated Azure CLI profile, hashed after the last probe returned; the measured probe source emitted only hostnameSha256 and requestIdSha256

formulas.probeSourceSha256: SHA-256 of the executed probe_endpoint.py bytes (CRLF Windows checkout of the measured commit)
formulas.identitySha256: SHA-256 of '<tenantId>:<objectId>' from the shared Azure CLI profile; the current probe emits the same formula from the token's tid and oid claims
formulas.requestSha256: SHA-256 of json.dumps({model, messages:[{role:user, content:prompt}], max_tokens:4, temperature:0}) with default separators

privateRunner.networkMode: Private IP in a linked VNet workload subnet
privateRunner.accessMethod: Outbound HTTPS to a privately resolved address; Private Endpoint use is inferred from dnsClass=private, not from an address match against the Private Endpoint NIC; not Azure Bastion

doesNotProve: Managed Compute pods are injected into the customer VNet
Managed Compute outbound traffic traverses the customer VNet
Service-side request timestamps or latency distributions
The Managed Compute deployment exposes no inbound hostname other than the parent account's services.ai.azure.com route; only that route was tested
The 403 originated inside the Managed Compute route; it is an account-boundary rejection of a request addressed to that deployment
